discoveries.text: The spec's scope_owns regex makes `harness-demo-x-svc` a lane unit of run demo: 08:21's negative assertion must change (P1-02), and run proj-<date> owns proj-<date>-2's units (gc's live-owner rule covers it).

Lane units and per-lane scratch change ~10 checks' text in 08 (unit regexes, svc_gaps, termed_left); plan §10.2 lists each with its rewrite. The stub's sessions.log/count-* and the fixture teardown markers must go to ${HARNESS_SCRATCH%%/lanes/*} so their checks keep their text.
Reopening a lane from origin/harness-lane/<run>/<m> is needed from P1-03 on (a segment that ends at a session cap mid-milestone, the dl runs), not only in P1-05.
lib/eval.sh:130 reads base..harness/$run for commits.json; with a record-only run branch it must read the run's tags and lane branches (10:130).
The live check.sh still runs the suite in full for a docs/plans-only change (209-234 s twice this session): the live checkout hasn't synced P0-03's key ignores while this run lives.

questions: D2 default: until P2's record PR, `harness gc` deletes a finished lanes run's record branch (the ledger keeps the record). Fine, or should P1 keep record branches until the record PR exists?

If this run auto-continues after P1 merges, the P1 driver's legacy refusal will stop it (this branch carries P2 code beyond main). Plan §14 gives the way out (harness merge, then a new --brief run). OK, or do you want P1-05 to exempt runs whose code is on their own branch only after a given date?
proposed_changes: P1-02 step 1: a milestone also opens when every feature passes but it isn't verified (a resumed run, the dl deadline runs); and add a pure `F deps <list> <m>` for the merge rule and the base
P1-02: tests/checks/08 line 21's `! scope_owns demo harness-demo-x-svc.scope` becomes `harness-demo-x-y-svc.scope` (the spec's regex accepts one-segment prefixes)
P1-03 step 7: 'every name still present' except the rename of 'independent M2 verified, not merged (M1 isn't)' (plan §10.2): the spec deletes the rule it asserted
P1-04 step 1: the unit number is scope-seq (every session of the run), not $STATE/sessions (coding only), so verify and coding units never share a name (plan D7)
P1-04: tests/checks rows of plan §10.2 (unit names) are rewritten in P1-04; 'every other check keeps its text' is not achievable with the spec's lane unit names
